title: 1987 Donruss Len Dykstra #611 New York Mets

descriptionText: The product is a 1987 Donruss Len Dykstra #611 trading card featuring the New York Mets player. This original single sports trading card is from the 1987 Donruss set, manufactured by Donruss for baseball enthusiasts. The card is a useful collectible for fans of Len Dykstra and the New York Mets, representing the player from the specified season. Ideal for sports trading card collectors, this item is a valuable piece of baseball memorabilia.
